plugin.name: mm_updater
plugin.author: Ferdinand
plugin.purpose: keeps Materia Magica plugins up to date
plugin.description:
Checks installed plugins against a signed update manifest and installs updates after your confirmation. Also updates old plugins that speak the plugins_updater_v3 protocol.
* update plugins -- check everything, list what is outdated * update plugin <name|id> -- update plugins matching a name or ID * update plugins lastlist -- install everything from the last check
Checks run automatically about once a day; nothing installs without you asking. Updates are verified against SHA-256 hashes from an RSA-signed manifest before touching disk; the previous version of every file is kept next to it with an .old suffix.
Keep mm_updater.lua, mm_crypto.lua and mm_http.lua in the same folder as this plugin. Requires TLS: always available on MacMUSH; on MUSHclient install LuaSec.

muclient.script:
local COLOURS = { text = "silver", dim = "gray", link = "cornflowerblue", error = "tomato", background = "", }
local function file_exists(path) local f = io.open(path, "rb") if f then f:close() return true end return false end
local plugin_dir = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 20) or "" for _, need in ipairs({ "mm_http.lua", "mm_crypto.lua", "mm_updater.lua" }) do assert(file_exists(plugin_dir .. need), "mm_updater: " .. need .. " must sit next to mm_updater.xml") end package.loaded.mm_http = nil package.loaded.mm_crypto = nil package.loaded.mm_updater = nil package.path = plugin_dir .. "?.lua;" .. package.path local http_lib = require "mm_http" local crypto = require "mm_crypto" local updater = require "mm_updater"
-- the client's native digests are faster than pure Lua when present; -- use_native vets them against known vectors before trusting them crypto.use_native({ sha256 = utils and utils.sha256, md5 = utils and utils.md5, })
local PUBKEY_N = ""
local CHECK_EVERY = 24 * 60 * 60 -- seconds between automatic checks
local function note(style, text) ColourNote(COLOURS[style] or COLOURS.text, COLOURS.background, text) end
local function link(text, command) ColourTell(COLOURS.text, COLOURS.background, text) Hyperlink(command, command, "", COLOURS.link, COLOURS.background, false) Note("") end
local fs = {}
function fs.read(path) local f = io.open(path, "rb") if not f then return nil end local s = f:read("*a") f:close() return s end
function fs.write(path, data) local f, err = io.open(path, "wb") if not f then return nil, err end f:write(data) f:close() return true end
function fs.rename(old, new) return os.rename(old, new) end function fs.remove(path) return os.remove(path) end fs.exists = file_exists
local WINDOWS = string.sub(package.config, 1, 1) == "\\"
function fs.mkdir(path) local ok, lfs = pcall(require, "lfs") if ok and lfs and lfs.attributes then if lfs.attributes(path, "mode") == "directory" then return true end end if WINDOWS then os.execute('cmd /C md "' .. string.gsub(path, "/", "\\") .. '" 2>nul') else os.execute('mkdir -p "' .. path .. '"') end return true end
local cl = {} cl.note = note cl.link = link function cl.plugin_list() return GetPluginList() or {} end function cl.plugin_info(id, n) return GetPluginInfo(id, n) end function cl.call_plugin(id, fn) return CallPlugin(id, fn) end function cl.reload_plugin(id) return ReloadPlugin(id) end function cl.get_var(name) return GetVariable(name) end function cl.set_var(name, value) SetVariable(name, value) SaveState() end function cl.app_dir() return GetInfo(56) end
local http = http_lib.new() local u = updater.new({ http = http, crypto = crypto, fs = fs, cl = cl, config = { base_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dptsec/mm-scripts/main/", pubkey_n = PUBKEY_N, legacy_manifest_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MateriaMagicaLLC/mm-mushclient-scripts/master/text/plugins_versions.txt", self_id = GetPluginID(), }, })
local pump_scheduled = false
local function schedule_pump() if pump_scheduled then return end pump_scheduled = true DoAfterSpecial(0.2, "updater_pump()", sendto.script) end
function updater_pump() pump_scheduled = false if http:tick() then schedule_pump() end end
local function require_tls() if http:tls_available() then return true end note("error", "mm_updater: HTTPS unavailable -- install LuaSec to use this plugin") return false end
local function finish_install(summary) if summary.self_updated then local code = ReloadPlugin(GetPluginID()) if code ~= 0 then note("text", "mm_updater: please reinstall me by hand:") note("text", " File -> Plugins, select mm_updater, click Reinstall") end end end
function updater_cmd_check() if not require_tls() then return end u:check(function(jobs, err) if err then note("error", "mm_updater: " .. err) elseif #jobs == 0 then note("text", "mm_updater: all plugins are up to date") else u:report() end end) schedule_pump() end
function updater_cmd_lastlist() if not require_tls() then return end u:install_all(finish_install) schedule_pump() end
function updater_cmd_one(name, line, wildcards) if not require_tls() then return end local what = string.lower(wildcards[1] or "") u:check(function(jobs, err) if err then note("error", "mm_updater: " .. err) return end local matched = {} for _, job in ipairs(jobs) do if job.id == wildcards[1] or string.find(string.lower(job.name), what, 1, true) then matched[#matched + 1] = job end end if #matched == 0 then note("text", string.format( "mm_updater: no pending updates match '%s'", wildcards[1])) return end u.jobs = matched u:install_all(finish_install) end) schedule_pump() end
function updater_cmd_help() ColourNote("silver", "black", GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 3)) end
function updater_auto_check() -- daily-gate timer fires hourly; only act when a day has really passed local last = tonumber(GetVariable("last_check") or "0") or 0 if os.time() - last < CHECK_EVERY then return end if not http:tls_available() then return end cl.set_var("last_check", tostring(os.time())) u:check(function(jobs, err) if not err and jobs and #jobs > 0 then u:report() end end) schedule_pump() end
function OnPluginInstall() note("dim", "mm_updater: type 'mm_updater help' for info") DoAfterSpecial(15, "updater_auto_check()", sendto.script) end
function OnPluginConnect() DoAfterSpecial(15, "updater_auto_check()", sendto.script) end
function OnPluginClose() u:cancel() end
function OnPluginDisable() u:cancel() end
